Subject: Need help with a breach of contract case

Hello, my name is Suresh Bose. I am a 41-year-old hardware dealer living in Vadodara. Our company has a breach of contract claim of Rs. 14,55,00,000 against Orchid Logistics Ltd, and the counterparty terminated the contract without notice. My case number is CS(COMM) 1066/2019 in the Vadodara Commercial Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 72698 97261 or email suresh.bose@example.com.
